title: Erdős's clique-partition conjecture
statement:
Let $H$ be a graph on $n=km$ vertices. A partition of $V(H)$ into $k$ sets each inducing an $m$-clique is called a **$k$-partition into $m$-cliques**. **Erdős's conjecture.** If

$$
\delta(H)\geq n\left(1-\frac{1}{m}\right),
$$

then $V(H)$ has a $k$-partition into $m$-cliques. This is equivalent to the equitable-coloring formulation below and was later proved by Hajnal and Szemerédi.
source_name: H. A. Kierstead, Alexandr Kostochka and Zimu Xiang, “Results and Problems on Equitable Coloring of Graphs”, arXiv:2504.14711 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.14711

Status: the source reports no resolution (as of April 2025); treated as **open**. (An automated reading suggested “solved”, which the source does not establish — worth checking against the literature.)
